verse.verse_1: When the heaven is split asunder
verse.verse_2: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
verse.verse_3: And when the earth is spread out
verse.verse_4: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
verse.verse_5: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
verse.verse_6: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
verse.verse_7: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
verse.verse_8: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
verse.verse_9: And will return unto his folk in joy.
verse.verse_10: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
verse.verse_12: And be thrown to scorching fire.
verse.verse_13: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
verse.verse_14: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
verse.verse_15: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
verse.verse_16: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
verse.verse_17: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
verse.verse_18: And by the moon when she is at the full,
verse.verse_19: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
verse.verse_20: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
verse.verse_21: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
verse.verse_22: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
verse.verse_23: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
verse.verse_24: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
verse.verse_25: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
